processing_steps_notes.value: 50-kg capacity, 125-kW medium-frequency chamber vacuum induction furnace; alumina-lined crucible of approximately 150 mm diameter and 300 mm height; soft iron pieces charged at bottom with aluminum pieces on top; evacuated to 10^-4 torr; melt poured at 1893 K into 80-mm-diameter split cast iron molds kept inside the vacuum chamber; resulting VIM Fe-7Al ingot sound and free from microcracks and hydrogen gas porosity.
